svg.title: One set of gates for agent, person and CI
svg.desc: An agent's edit or commit goes through its hooks in .claude/hooks/design-system, a person's commit through the git pre-commit hook, and CI calls the core directly. All three run a stage of design-system/harness/run-gates.mjs, which reads design-system/gates.json and runs the token and rules checks against the DTCG tokens and DESIGN.md. The hooks only translate Claude Code's input and answer; every decision is the core's, and nothing under design-system/ names an agent. a commit with a raw colour: A person → pre-commit → harness/run-gates.mjs → checks/. the commit again, fixed: A person → pre-commit → harness/run-gates.mjs → checks/ → tokens/, DESIGN.md.

g.text: DTCG, the one source of values
